text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often clean up messy code to make it easier to read and understand. This is important because clear code helps teams work faster and make fewer mistakes. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which builds up when quick fixes are used instead of proper solutions. By regularly improving code structure, programmers keep their projects healthy and easier to maintain in the future. Remember, the key rule is simple: the behavior stays the same, but the code becomes better.
